name: Sechan Electronics
old_description: Defense Electronics Manufacturing for the Department of Defense
about:
Sechan Electronics is headquartered in Lititz, Pennsylvania. The company operates as a 100% employee-owned business through an ESOP structure. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm provides electronic contract manufacturing services focused on defense applications. Its production capabilities include circuit card assembly, wiring harness fabrication, and end-item integration, supported by automated through-hole component insertion equipment. Sechan also offers electrical, environmental, and EMI/EMC testing, along with design services governed by CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9000 procedures covering project planning, inventory control, integration, verification, and validation.

Sechan serves the U.S. Department of Defense and its prime contractors exclusively. Customer references include the U.S. Air Force, Army, Navy, and Marine Corps, as well as major primes such as BAE Systems, Boeing, Draper Laboratory, Johnson Controls, L3Harris Technologies, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Raytheon Technologies, Sierra Nevada Corporation, Textron Systems, and Ultra Electronics.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: it is solely dedicated to DoD work, it positions itself as solution-driven with engineering-heavy support for troubleshooting and circuit analysis, and its employee-ownership model aims to align incentives with customer success. Additional distinguishing factors include resident DCMA personnel, extensive product and data security experience, and high-reliability engineering expertise.
